item.title: A look at Ramadan and how Muslims observe the holy month
item.description: For Muslims, Ramadan is a time for increased worship, religious reflection and charity.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Windy through evening with isolated showers; chilly overnight
item.description: It will remain windy through this evening with isolated showers. Overnight, the temperatures will take a nosedive and tomorrow morning, a number of cold weather alerts will go into effect. You get a break from the rain tomorrow.

item.title: Closing arguments begin for Los Gatos mom accused of hosting drunken teen sex parties
item.description: Prosecutors say she is charged with crimes back in 2021, but the teens testified their involvement with O'Connor dated back to 2019 - when some of them were as young as 11 years old. Parties were held at her home, local parks and even hotels.

item.title: Oscars Pick'em: Can you predict the winners of the 2026 Oscars?
item.description: Think you know who will win big at the 98th Academy Awards? Then it's time to play Oscars Pick'em!

item.title: Dangerous conditions delay recovery of skiers killed in Castle Peak avalanche
item.description: Authorities in California say it will be at least another day before crews can attempt to recover the bodies of eight people killed in an avalanche and one other who remains missing.

item.title: Missing Bay Area skier found dead at Northstar, marking Tahoe resort's 3rd death this month
item.description: A skier who was reported missing Wednesday night at Northstar resort in Truckee was found dead Thursday morning by search crews, the Placer County Sheriff's Office said. Authorities identified the man as 21-year-old Colin Kang of Fremont, who was an off-duty employee at the resort.

item.title: Oakland's Alysa Liu gives US its first women's figure skating Olympic gold in 24 years
item.description: Oakland's own Alysa Liu won Olympic gold for the U.S. in women's figure skating, ending a 24-year drought, after delivering a near-flawless skate. Liu had returned to the sport after stepping away following the Beijing Games.

item.title: Castle Peak avalanche: What we know about 6 moms among 9 skiers presumed dead
item.description: Six women killed in an avalanche in the Castle Peak avalanche were among a group of eight close friends and experienced backcountry skiers on a trip together, their families said in a statement Thursday.

item.title: Trump says he doesn't know if aliens are real but directs government to release files on UFOs, more
item.description: President Donald Trump said Thursday that he's directing the Pentagon and other government agencies to identify and release files related to extraterrestrials and UFOs because of "tremendous interest."

item.title: Super Bowl anti-human trafficking operations lead to 73 rescued, 29 arrested in Bay Area
item.description: The Human Trafficking Task Force for Santa Clara County says of the 73 survivors, 10 were minors. "The youngest victim we saw was 12 years old, which is extremely tragic," said Lt. Singleton.
